note: dreamcore answer sheet (D-064). Written 2026-10-23 before any measurement of these recordings. role = positive | negative. Each track carries the verbatim source line, URL, retrieval date and certainty grade on the CASEBOOK 6-grade scale (D-033 supplement 6). aliases are identity facts for preview verification (sonic-profile RULES 1), not tuning. scope: global = non-Korean release, kr = Korean release.
sense: dreamcore as the internet aesthetic (Namu 드림코어 · Wikipedia Dreamcore (aesthetic)). Homonyms excluded before measurement: melodic-hardcore 'dreamcore' (Dreambound scene, PopMatters) and atmospheric drum and bass 'dreamcore' (Last.fm wiki, per search snippet).

S1.what: Namu Wiki, 드림코어, section 3 대중매체에서 > 음악 (list of four songs) and section 2 상세
S1.grade_basis: general wiki, single source, the list has no footnotes. DRAFT-answer-sheet-corpus §2 puts a wiki list at 중간; CASEBOOK puts fan wikis at 낮음. Namu is a general wiki, so 중간 with the no-footnote caveat.
S1.line: 음악의 경우 앰비언트나 Lo-Fi, 베이퍼웨이브 등 몽환적이거나 레트로한 분위기의 음악이 주로 사용된다.

S2.what: Bugs 뮤직PD 앨범 '우리가 잊은 시간들 #드림코어플리' (user-curated, registered 2024.02.13, 14 tracks)
S2.grade_basis: one user curator (뮤직PD is an open application program). Not an algorithmic playlist, so not excluded by DRAFT-answer-sheet-corpus §2, but a single unvetted list = 낮음.

S3.what: Wikipedia song articles (genre infobox and prose), one per negative

negative_selection_rule: Recorded before the pages were read: a 2024~2026 K-pop recording is a negative when its English Wikipedia article names at least one of trap, hip hop, house, EDM, hardstyle, techno, phonk, Brazilian/baile funk, reggaeton in the genre infobox or prose, and the article uses no musical descriptor dream, dreamy, ambient or ethereal. 18 pages fetched, 11 pass, 7 fail (Go!/redirected to album, Too Bad: K-pop only, Dirty Work: dance only, Rich Man: dance only, Style: dance and bubblegum pop, Hot: pop disco rock, Tunnel Vision: no genre line).
